newsitem.title: USA: Conrail hearing to focus on government.
newsitem.headline: Conrail hearing to focus on government.

text.p: A House Transportation Committee hearing next month on a possible acquisition of Conrail Inc will focus on the government's action in the proceeding, the panel's chairman said Wednesday.

"Our hearing (Nov. 19) will basically focus on the process that the Surface Transporation Board will use in making the determinations on any proposals to acquire Conrail," Rep. Bud Schuster, R-Pa. said in a statement. "This hearing will not get into the specifics or merits of competing proposals (by CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp )."
